The call to `defineExtensionConfigSchema` in the core framework is `packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/module-config.ts:445`. It validates the schema, merges it with the implicit schema, and stores it per extension name. Changing that behaviour would affect five schema objects in the patient chart and the extensions that read them.

**Registrations (call sites)**
- `packages/esm-patient-flags-app/src/index.ts` calls it for `patient-flags-risk-count` and `patient-flags-list` (lines 12–13).
- `packages/esm-patient-banner-app/src/index.ts` calls it for `person-attribute-tag` (line 25).
- `packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/index.ts` calls it for `obs-by-encounter-widget` and `obs-table-horizontal-widget` (lines 21–22).

**Schema objects passed in**
- `riskCountExtensionConfigSchema` (flags risk count), `packages/esm-patient-flags-app/src/flags/flags-risk-count-extension/extension-config-schema.ts`.
- `flagsListExtensionConfigSchema` (flags list), `packages/esm-patient-flags-app/src/flags/flags-list-extension/extension-config-schema.ts`.
- `personAttributeTagsExtensionConfigSchema`, `packages/esm-patient-banner-app/src/banner-tags/person-attribute-tags.extension.tsx`.
- `configSchemaSwitchable` (obs switchable widget), `packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/config-schema-obs-switchable.ts`.
- `configSchemaHorizontal` (obs horizontal widget), `packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/config-schema-obs-horizontal.ts`.

**Consumers that read the config through `useConfig`**
- `packages/esm-patient-flags-app/src/flags/flags-list-extension/flags-list.extension.tsx` (line 12) reads `tags`.
- `packages/esm-patient-banner-app/src/banner-tags/person-attribute-tags.extension.tsx` (lines 24–25) reads `attributeType`.
- `packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/obs-switchable/obs-switchable.component.tsx` (line 19) and `packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/obs-graph/obs-graph.component.tsx` (line 21) read `ConfigObjectSwitchable`.
- `packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/obs-table/obs-table.component.tsx` (line 40) reads `ConfigObjectSwitchable`.
- `packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/resources/useObs.ts` (line 43) reads `encounterTypes` and `data`.

I did not open the risk-count extension component or the horizontal obs table component, so they are not in the list below. They are probably affected too. The three obs-table/graph/switchable components are the ones I confirmed.

The `flags-list.component.tsx` hits (lines 17 and 75) use a generic `ConfigObject`, so I left them out as not clearly tied to this schema.
